newsitem.title: GREECE: OLYMPIC MEDALIST TO WIND SURF ACROSSS AEGEAN SEA.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPIC MEDALIST TO WIND SURF ACROSSS AEGEAN SEA.

text.p: Greece's Olympic gold medalist Nickos Kaklamanakis will attempt to wind surf across the Aegean sea on Wednesday and cover 120 nautical miles from the temple of Poseidon at Sounion, Athens to the beach of Amoudi in the isle of Santorini.
The athlete chose Wednesday expecting favourable northerly winds.
Kaklamanakis will spend Wednesday evening in Santorini and start the second leg of his journey on Thursday. He will wind surf all the way down to Heraklion in Crete, finishing off at Carteros beach.
He will be escorted by a Greek navy vessel and three power boats. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
